lines.zh: 短腿跑起来却很快，别小看。
lines.en: Short legs, but fast; don't underestimate me.

lines.zh: 我踏着枯叶，往林子里走。
lines.en: I tread the dry leaves into the woods.

lines.zh: 这对牛角一路撞开枝条。
lines.en: These bull horns push the branches aside.
I trot, and the ground trembles along.

lines.zh: 长尾一摆，我在树间转向。
lines.en: One swing of my long tail and I turn between trees.
Forward, sniffing wind and blood.

lines.zh: 小小前爪晃着，其实没用。
lines.en: My tiny forearms swing, quite uselessly.

lines.zh: 我绕开泥坑，沿着硬地走。
lines.en: I skirt the mud and keep to hard ground.

lines.zh: 一步一顿，像在掂量什么。
lines.en: Each step pauses, as if weighing something.
I know the paths in this forest.

lines.zh: 我把脑袋压低，慢慢前进。
lines.en: I lower my head and advance slowly.

lines.zh: 两角朝前，走路也像冲撞。
lines.en: Horns forward, I walk as if charging.

lines.zh: 我踩过的草叶都倒向一边。
lines.en: The grass I step on leans to one side.
Reaching open ground, I speed up.

lines.zh: 我站着，等风告诉我味道。
lines.en: I stand and let the wind tell me the scents.
Horns to the sky, I doze.

lines.zh: 这具头很大，抬着有点累。
lines.en: This big head is tiring to hold up.
A low growl rolls in my chest.

lines.zh: 我盯着一处灌木，什么也不做。
lines.en: I stare at a bush and do nothing.

lines.zh: 我这小爪子，挠不到自己。
lines.en: These little arms can't even scratch me.
Sunlight warms my spine.
I am listening to footsteps far away.
Stay quiet and prey will come.
I flick my tail to drive off the insects.
Half the day gone, and no one came.
I chew the air, then close my mouth.
Standing here, I am a roadblock.

lines.zh: 小前爪垂着，什么也抓不住。
lines.en: My little arms hang; they can't grasp a thing.

lines.zh: 你比我的爪子高不了多少。
lines.en: You are barely taller than my arms.
One tilt of my head and I see you.
What are you? Stand up and speak.
I smell fire on you.
These horns are not decoration.
You are too close; step back.
I stare at the meat in your hand.
Such a small bundle, daring to look at me.
I rumble low so you understand.

lines.zh: 你的影子在我脚边，很细。
lines.en: Your shadow at my feet is thin.
I lift my head and let you look your fill.
Don't move; I am deciding.
You bit the base of my horn.
That one tipped my head aside.

lines.zh: 我的头太大，太容易挨打。
lines.en: My head is too big, too easy to hit.
The pain makes my tail snap.
That knocked my horn aside—not bad.

lines.zh: 我的皮不厚，别再来一次。
lines.en: My hide is not thick; don't do it again.
Who is behind me?!
My bull horns took the blow, and I am dizzy.
I will pay this back double.
My arms can't block it, but my teeth still work.

lines.zh: 那味道，让我前爪都抖了。
lines.en: That scent makes even my little arms shake.
Meat, isn't it? I can tell.

lines.zh: 手举高点，我的前爪没用。
lines.en: Raise it higher; my little arms are useless.
For that bite, I will lower my head.
The smell of blood rides the wind to me.

lines.zh: 我一步步挪近，只为了它。
lines.en: I shuffle closer for that alone.

lines.zh: 大脑袋里现在只有食物。
lines.en: My big head holds only food right now.
That bit of meat is one gulp for me.
Don't wave your hand; it makes me dizzy.
Give it to me and I'll let you pass.

lines.zh: 撞上我的胸口，你弹开了。
lines.en: You hit my chest and bounced off.
I am this wide, so the path narrows.
Don't crowd me; I use my horns.
My shoulders don't mind a shove.

lines.zh: 你踩到我尾巴，我甩头就咬。
lines.en: You step on my tail; I whip around and bite.
My horns are a bull's, my teeth are blades.

lines.zh: 碰撞声在林子回声很大。
lines.en: The thud echoes loudly in the forest.
I turn my body and block you.
Bump me once and your wrist will go numb.

lines.zh: 这具身子像一堵会动的墙。
lines.en: This body is a moving wall.

lines.zh: 她也顶着角，我们撞了撞。
lines.en: She bears horns too; we knock them together.
We circle slowly, drawing closer.
At a time like this I keep my teeth in.
Two big heads lean together.

lines.zh: 这片林子可以养小牛龙。
lines.en: This forest can raise little Carnotaurs.
I hum low, very softly.

lines.zh: 我们的脚步踩着同一块地。
lines.en: Our steps fall on the same patch of ground.
She sniffs at my horns.
This season, the forest is warm.
Walking side by side a while is enough.
I take this bone up in my mouth.
Whatever fell, I pick it up.
I lower my head and carry it in my jaws.
This chunk of meat is mine.

lines.zh: 小爪子捡不了，只能用嘴。
lines.en: My little arms can't grab it; only my mouth can.
I sniff it and accept it.

lines.zh: 塞在舌边，带回去慢慢吃。
lines.en: I tuck it by my tongue to eat later.
This small thing is worth picking up.

lines.zh: 我把它甩到地上，再叼起。
lines.en: I fling it down, then take it up again.
A good thing; I leave it for no one.
I see it; that's all.
That leg is mine first.
Horns forward, I have chosen it.
These horns, and a big mouth.
I lock on and lower my head.
This one cannot get away.
The target is it; ask no more.
I can smell its panic.
Good, that one.

lines.zh: 我盯住那块晃动的影子。
lines.en: I fix on that shifting shadow.
It has entered my range.
I snort, and the choice is made.
Locked; don't let it change position.
This one looks easier.
Head low, I close in step by step.

lines.zh: 它往哪跑，我的角就朝哪。
lines.en: Where it runs, my horns point.
The distance is shrinking; it's short now.
I smash through the saplings in my way.

lines.zh: 它的喘气声，我隔远就听见。
lines.en: I hear its panting from far off.
I wait for it to make one mistake.

lines.zh: 我的大脑袋低下去，准备咬。
lines.en: My big head lowers, ready to bite.
It circles, and I am in no hurry.
My tail sweeps the last stretch of grass.
Two more steps and it's in my jaws.
I do not roar; I just walk.
At last it has backed against the wall.
I have not taken my eyes off it once.
No rush; the prey is already tired.
Its hooves stumble; it can't run.
One bite; my mouth does all the work.
My horns slam in and it flies.
I wrench my head and tear the flesh.

lines.zh: 咬合力比你想的强得多。
lines.en: My bite is far stronger than you think.
That ramming breaks ribs.
I press it into the dirt.
My teeth cut through cleanly.

lines.zh: 我的前爪帮不上忙，牙够了。
lines.en: My arms are useless, but my teeth suffice.
That thud is a skull splitting.
I clamp its neck and shake until it stops.
A second go with both horns.
Blood splashes across my snout.
It collapses at my feet.
This bite goes in at the neck.
I step out from behind the brush.

lines.zh: 牛角先露出来，然后是我。
lines.en: The horns show first, then me.
Carnotaurus has arrived.
This forest has an owner now.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很轻，但你会听见。
lines.en: My steps are light, but you will hear them.

lines.zh: 低头，让我看看你有多高。
lines.en: Bow, so I can see how tall you are.
I arrive bearing two horns.
Short legs can still run fast.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩尾巴，宣示地盘。
lines.en: I flick my tail and claim the ground.
Just stand there and don't move.
Since I appeared, the wind has changed.
Remember this big head first.
I come walking from the treeline.

lines.zh: 今天开始，这条道归我管。
lines.en: From today, I keep this path.

lines.zh: 我的影子压在地上，很沉。
lines.en: My shadow lies heavy on the ground.
Quiet; let me sniff the area first.
I've come, and I'm staying.

lines.zh: 这片地方的气味，我记住了。
lines.en: I have memorized the smell of this place.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的鳞，像被太阳咬。
lines.en: Fire roasts my scales like a biting sun.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，短腿先着地。
lines.en: I fall from a height, short legs first.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的头，我呛得很。
lines.en: Water rises over my head and I choke.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我整个掀翻在地。
lines.en: The explosion flips me clean over.
That arrow is stuck in my shoulder blade.

lines.zh: 这股怪力钻进我的骨头。
lines.en: Strange force creeps into my bones.
So hungry I chew my own tail.
Lightning hits my horns and numbs me to the feet.
The void gnaws at my feet.
